name: Droneacharya Aerial Innovation
summary: DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations Ltd., also known as Droneacharya Aerial Innovation, provides a range of specialized drone-based solutions. These services primarily involve conducting multi-sensor aerial surveys and subsequently analyzing the data gathered by drones. The company was established by Prateek Srivastava on March 10, 2017, and operates from its headquarters in Pune, India.
